main_text.head: Syllabus Capitum.
main_text.l: 19. De vario Belli successu, Victoriis & Cladibus. 170
22. Cum abiret Rex ab Oxonio & se ad Scotos reciperet. 196
23. Cum Scoti Regem Anglis tra-derent, & de Custodia Holmbejana. 200

page.notes: Long s read as f in "controverfiis", "Belli fuccessu", "Epiftolis" and "Regi fui"; transcribed as s. "Parlamcnti" is read as "Parlamenti" (the e is worn). "Regi sui" is read as "fui" in the scan and corrected to "sui" from the sense. Small dot below the last line and the edge marks at both margins are not text and are left out. Page ends mid-entry at "terci-", which continues on the next page.
